sentences.text:
Indal Ravidas @ Inder Ravidas .... Petitioner Versus
1. The State of Jharkhand
2. Mamta Kumari .... Opposite Parties ....
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ranjan Kr. Singh, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : None  ....
07/18.05.2023 The applicant, who is in custody since 20.08.2022, has approac Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Mahagama P.S. Case No.135 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 341/ 323/ 498A/376(2)(n)/ 504/ 506/34 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of D.P. Act.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that it is a family dispute which has been aggravated.

The allegation of rape is against other family members and this applicant has been charged under Sections 323/
498A/ 504/ 506 of IPC.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

In spite of valid service of notice,
nobody appears on behalf of the wife.
Considering the materials available on record and the period of custody, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on bail, on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Godda, in connection with Mahagama P.S. Case No.135 of 2022, on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below Indal Ravidas @ Inder Ravidas vs The State Of Jharkhand on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39998536/
1 which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
